states.name: S0
states.meaning: Initial/reset state: no nonempty suffix of the received stream matches a prefix of 1101; start_shifting=0. On posedge: reset==1 forces S0; else data==1 -> S1, data==0 -> S0.
states.update_time: posedge clk; synchronous reset forces S0

states.name: S1
states.meaning: Last received bit is the first 1 of 1101; start_shifting=0. On posedge with reset==0: data==1 -> S2, data==0 -> S0.

states.name: S2
states.meaning: Last two received bits are 11; start_shifting=0. On posedge with reset==0: data==0 -> S3, data==1 -> S2.

states.name: S3
states.meaning: Last three received bits are 110; start_shifting=0. On posedge with reset==0: data==1 -> S4, data==0 -> S0.

states.name: S4
states.meaning: Sequence 1101 has been found; start_shifting is latched at 1. On posedge: reset==1 -> S0; else any data stays S4 and start_shifting remains 1.

rules.condition: On a posedge with reset==1, reset has priority: state becomes S0 and start_shifting becomes 0 after the edge regardless of data.
On a posedge with reset==0, if state==S4 or (state==S3 and data==1), then after the edge start_shifting=1 and state is S4; while reset==0, S4 holds start_shifting=1 for all data.
rules.spec_quote: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.

rules.condition: On a posedge with reset==0 and not [state==S4 or (state==S3 and data==1)], after the edge start_shifting=0; state follows the 1101-prefix transitions: S0+0->S0, S0+1->S1, S1+0->S0, S1+1->S2, S2+0->S3, S2+1->S2, S3+0->S0.

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: The first posedge with reset==0 after a posedge with reset==1; immediately after that edge the FSM is S0 and start_shifting is 0.

mid: If a vector has mid, it changes reset/data after the sampled posedge and before the next posedge; the changed values are carried to the start of the next row's pre-edge inputs.

uncertain.note: The spec states synchronous active-high reset and that the found condition lasts until reset, but it does not explicitly state the reset value of start_shifting; this contract chooses 0 on reset.
candidates: start_shifting retains previous value after reset

uncertain.note: The spec says start_shifting is set to 1 when 1101 is found and held until reset, but it does not explicitly state the pre-detection/default value; this contract chooses 0 before detection.
